verdict.rationale: Unstructured's processed output is in open, documented formats: consistent JSON document elements, custom-schema JSON, and HTML for tables. Results can be downloaded via the Job APIs or delivered to your own destinations through 35+ connectors, so processed data is not locked in. However, nothing documents exporting everything in an account (workflow definitions, job history, configuration) or any offboarding path. Missing for 10: account-wide data export, export of workflow/pipeline definitions, documented offboarding or data-deletion process, independent corroboration.
